columns.name: item_5_sold_in_day_with_highest_temp_2012
columns.description: The number of units sold for item no. 5 in the store on the day in 2012 with the highest temperature. If multiple days share the highest temperature, return the maximum units sold among those days, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: item_7_sold_in_day_with_biggest_temp_range
columns.description: The number of units of item no.7 were sold in store on the day the temperature range was the biggest, If multiple days share the biggest temperature range, return the maximum units sold among those days, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_item_5_sold_2012
columns.description: The percentage of the units of item no.5 sold among all units of items sold in store in 2012.

columns.name: avg_item_5_sold_when_max_temp_exceeded_90
columns.description: The average number of units of item no.5 sold in store when the maximum temperature exceeded 90.

columns.name: num_items_sold_during_a_snowy_day
columns.description: The number of units of  items were sold by the store during a snowy day, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_stores
columns.description: The number of stores in the station, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: quantity_of_item_5_sold
columns.description: The quantity of item number 5 overall in the station, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: avg_maximum_temp_Feb_2012
columns.description: The station's average maximum temperature in February 2012.

columns.name: most_purchased_products
columns.description: The most purchased products  in the station, with ties broken by the ascending order of the item number.

columns.name: item_9_sold_when_avg_temp_less_than_83
columns.description: The number of units are being sold for item 9 in the station when the average temperature is less than 83, replace NULL values with 0.
